name: insight-cards
title: Insight Cards
summary: Insights from an agent, one at a time, each with a small chart.
description: Paged insights from an agent: a header with the count and a pager, then one insight at a time. Each insight is a sentence (with entity chips and value pills), a small card with a legend and an inline SVG chart, and a follow-up button. The chart is drawn by a shared builder (insight-chart.ts) in every target, has a text alternative, and never animates. Pages stack in one cell, so the component is as tall as its tallest insight and paging never shifts what sits below it.

anatomy.description: Title (with a plain Count) and the pager: a Pager with loop, layout start, label 'Choose insight', buttons 'Previous insight' / 'Next insight'; its position is the role=status '2 of 3'. With no insights an empty-state row (centred) replaces the pages.
The title and a plain Count of the insights
One grid cell all pages share
role=group, aria-roledescription=slide; data-state=active|inactive (inactive pages are visibility: hidden, so they keep their size but leave the tab order and the accessibility tree)
The insight as a sentence: text, EntityChip and ValuePill
Swatch + label; title carries the full name
Series name; truncates at the end
Latest value (line, bar) or share; tabular, never truncated
role=img with a generated aria-label; data-kind=line|bar|share. Shapes come from chartShapes()
Follow-up prompt; an outline sm Button

items.title: string
items.summary: string | Array<string | { entity: string, color?: string } | { value: string, tone?: 'neutral'|'green'|'orange'|'red'|'accent' }>
items.chart: { kind: 'line'|'bar'|'share', series: { name, values: number[], tone?: 'accent'|'orange'|'red'|'green'|'neutral' }[], format?: 'number'|'percent'|'money', threshold?: number, label?: string }?

insights.description: The insights, in order. Owned by the parent: pass a new array to change them.

page.description: Index of the insight shown. Clamped to the list.

tone.description: Per series (chart.series[].tone): colour of its swatch and of its line, bars or segment.

events.action: (id: string) the follow-up button of an insight was pressed

a11y.role: region (carousel) with a pager group and a status
keyboard: Tab reaches the previous and next buttons, then the follow-up button of the shown insight
Enter / Space on previous or next change the page; focus stays on the button
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight while focus is in the pager change the page (mirrored right-to-left); Home / End jump to the first and last
Paging wraps around; with one insight or none the buttons are aria-disabled (they keep focus)
notes: The position ('2 of 3') sits in a role=status region, so a page change is announced.
Every chart is role=img with a text alternative generated from its data (or chart.label).
Inactive pages are visibility: hidden: out of the tab order and the accessibility tree.

motion: page change: instant. No crossfade (not even a short blur): the pager is used many times in a row and from the keyboard, and the content is data
chart: never animates, on mount or on page change
pager buttons and follow-up button: the shared Button press and gated hover
